newsitem.title: USA: Texas Veterans Housing program $48 mln priced.
newsitem.headline: Texas Veterans Housing program $48 mln priced.

text.p: Alex. Brown & Son Inc said it tentatively priced $48 million of Texas Veterans Housing Assistance Program, Fund Series 1995 E, refunding bonds, with a top yield of 6.20 percent in 2026.
The bonds are rated Aa Moody's Investors Service and AA by Standard & Poor's Corp.
The bonds are dated 11/6/1996. The first coupon is 6/1/1997 and due 12/1.
The bonds are callable 12/1/2006 at 102.00, declining to par 12/1/2010.
The award is expected Thursday, October 24. Delivery is expected on November 6, 1996.
Co-managers include Smith Barney Inc, Prudential Securities Inc, Artemis Capital Group Inc and Walton Johnson & Co.
